name: SSH Key Generator
description: Generate an OpenSSH key pair with the private key, an authorized_keys line and a SHA256 fingerprint.

hints.algorithm: The first version supports unencrypted private keys only: the passphrase-encrypted variant needs a bcrypt KDF that the upstream library does not yet provide.
hints.output: Keep the private key safe; the fingerprint lets you confirm both ends match.

faq.q: Can it generate a passphrase-protected key?
faq.a: Not yet. It needs a bcrypt KDF and encrypted-key format conversion, which must come from the upstream library rather than a home-grown fallback.

faq.q: What format is the private key in?
faq.a: The openssh-key-v1 format, which can be written straight to ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.
